name: Retail Stock Balance
query:
SELECT
    q.retail_stock_item AS "Retail Stock Item:Link/Retail Stock Item:220",
    q.stock_item_name AS "Stock Item Name:Data:220",
    q.metal AS "Metal:Data:90",

    q.total_in AS "Total In:Float:120",
    q.total_out AS "Total Out:Float:120",
    q.current_stock AS "Current Stock:Float:140",

    q.article_category AS "Article Category:Link/Jewellery Item Type:160",
    q.purity AS "Purity:Link/Metal Purity:130",
    q.gold_size AS "Gold Size:Data:100",
    q.silver_size AS "Silver Size:Data:100",
    q.brand AS "Brand:Data:100",
    q.variant_design AS "Variant / Design:Data:160"

FROM (

    /* ========================================================
       SECTION HEADER
       ======================================================== */
    SELECT
        0 AS section_order,
        0 AS metal_order,
        'SUMMARY_HEADER' AS row_type,

        NULL AS retail_stock_item,
        'CURRENT RETAIL STOCK SUMMARY' AS stock_item_name,
        NULL AS metal,

        NULL AS total_in,
        NULL AS total_out,
        NULL AS current_stock,

        NULL AS article_category,
        NULL AS purity,
        NULL AS gold_size,
        NULL AS silver_size,
        NULL AS brand,
        NULL AS variant_design


    UNION ALL


    /* ========================================================
       GOLD SUMMARY
       ======================================================== */
    SELECT
        1 AS section_order,
        1 AS metal_order,
        'SUMMARY' AS row_type,

        NULL AS retail_stock_item,
        NULL AS stock_item_name,
        'GOLD' AS metal,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_in,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_out,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            )
            -
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS current_stock,

        NULL AS article_category,
        NULL AS purity,
        NULL AS gold_size,
        NULL AS silver_size,
        NULL AS brand,
        NULL AS variant_design

    FROM `tabJewellery Stock Transaction` rst

    LEFT JOIN `tabRetail Stock Item` rsi
        ON rsi.name = rst.retail_stock_item

    WHERE
        rst.retail_stock_item IS NOT NULL
        AND rsi.metal = 'Gold'


    UNION ALL


    /* ========================================================
       SILVER SUMMARY
       ======================================================== */
    SELECT
        1 AS section_order,
        2 AS metal_order,
        'SUMMARY' AS row_type,

        NULL AS retail_stock_item,
        NULL AS stock_item_name,
        'SILVER' AS metal,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_in,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_out,

        ROUND(
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            )
            -
            COALESCE(
                SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                        THEN rst.weight
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ),
                0
            ),
            3
        ) AS current_stock,

        NULL AS article_category,
        NULL AS purity,
        NULL AS gold_size,
        NULL AS silver_size,
        NULL AS brand,
        NULL AS variant_design

    FROM `tabJewellery Stock Transaction` rst

    LEFT JOIN `tabRetail Stock Item` rsi
        ON rsi.name = rst.retail_stock_item

    WHERE
        rst.retail_stock_item IS NOT NULL
        AND rsi.metal = 'Silver'


    UNION ALL


    /* ========================================================
       DETAILS HEADER
       ======================================================== */
    SELECT
        2 AS section_order,
        0 AS metal_order,
        'DETAIL_HEADER' AS row_type,

        NULL AS retail_stock_item,
        'RETAIL STOCK DETAILS' AS stock_item_name,
        NULL AS metal,

        NULL AS total_in,
        NULL AS total_out,
        NULL AS current_stock,

        NULL AS article_category,
        NULL AS purity,
        NULL AS gold_size,
        NULL AS silver_size,
        NULL AS brand,
        NULL AS variant_design


    UNION ALL


    /* ========================================================
       INDIVIDUAL RETAIL STOCK ITEMS
       ======================================================== */
    SELECT
        3 AS section_order,

        CASE
            WHEN rsi.metal = 'Gold' THEN 1
            WHEN rsi.metal = 'Silver' THEN 2
            ELSE 3
        END AS metal_order,

        'DETAIL' AS row_type,

        rst.retail_stock_item,
        rsi.stock_item_name,
        rsi.metal,

        ROUND(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_in,

        ROUND(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            3
        ) AS total_out,

        ROUND(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
            -
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            3
        ) AS current_stock,

        rst.item AS article_category,
        rst.purity,
        rsi.gold_size,
        rsi.silver_size,
        rsi.brand,
        rsi.variant_design

    FROM `tabJewellery Stock Transaction` rst

    LEFT JOIN `tabRetail Stock Item` rsi
        ON rsi.name = rst.retail_stock_item

    WHERE
        rst.retail_stock_item IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY
        rst.retail_stock_item,
        rsi.stock_item_name,
        rsi.metal,
        rst.item,
        rst.purity,
        rsi.gold_size,
        rsi.silver_size,
        rsi.brand,
        rsi.variant_design

    HAVING
        %(view)s = 'Full View'
        OR
        ROUND(
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'In'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
            -
            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN rst.movement = 'Out'
                    THEN rst.weight
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ),
            3
        ) > 0
) q

ORDER BY
    q.section_order,
    q.metal_order,
    q.stock_item_name,
    q.retail_stock_item;
